policy: Official ESP32 DEFAULT returns and independent frozen C161+v5 native events. Simulate common 256-sample delivery, 160-sample FIFO production and two seconds of pre-roll. Send both lanes to the real P4 QEMU Opus binary, decode and transcribe unprompted on GPU. For shipped v5, byte-validate every lane against the 18 earlier P4 listener+codec captures. A late notification may retain a complete command. No new hours or independent speakers from reusing commands.
